tables.name: user_wallets
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX user_wallets_pkey ON public.user_wallets USING btree (user_id)

tables.name: wallet_transactions
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_transactions_idempotency_uidx ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_transactions_pkey ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX wallet_transactions_user_idx ON public.wallet_transactions USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)
